crew.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
crew.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.
crew.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1

crew.overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.
crew.title: Iron Man 3

crew.overview: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.
crew.title: Captain America: The First Avenger

crew.overview: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!
crew.title: The Avengers

crew.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
crew.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.
crew.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

details.biography: Visual effects artists based out of Norfolk, NE, with over 10 years combined experience between roto, paint, and compositing.
details.name: Nathaniel Caauwe
